name: Artivo Shades New Build
lede: On a part-built project with a pergola already in place, Artivo Shades wanted heat that kept a clean, modern look. Platinum Electric heaters, recessed with the Low Clearance Recess Kit, sit flush in the ceiling.
data: New build – outdoor entertaining space with pergola
Platinum Smart-Heat® Electric · Low Clearance Recess Kit

hero.caption: Platinum Electric recessed flush in a timber-lined ceiling. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: The client wanted an outdoor entertaining space usable all year. The project was part-built when the heaters were specified, with an outdoor pergola already in place.
The heating had to keep a minimalist, modern look, and the recess had to work with construction that was already under way.

Bromic’s design service recommended the Platinum Electric Low Clearance Recess Kit, whose lower clearance requirements make installation easier, and the heaters were recessed directly into the ceiling.

quote.text: The Platinum Electric heaters are so clean and modern looking that people don’t even recognize them as heaters.
